title: Thick of It (KSI)
blurb: 'In the thick of it, everybody knows...' — KSI's track that became the internet's most remixed hook, spawning an entire genre of edits where the lyrics get replaced with increasingly unhinged nonsense. The original is the foundation; every brainrot variant builds on it. Play it as a flex, a bit, or the opening statement of a rap battle nobody agreed to.
origin: From KSI's 'Thick of It' — the internet's most-remixed hook.
